title: Demo Quiz
subject: A Demo
description: A tiny sample quiz showing single-choice, true/false and multi-select questions.

questions.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars appears red because its surface is covered in iron-oxide (rust). Venus is cloudy-yellow, Jupiter and Saturn are gas giants.

questions.question: The Sun is a star.
questions.explanation: The Sun is the star at the centre of our solar system; planets orbit around it.

questions.question: Select all the even numbers.
questions.explanation: Even numbers are divisible by 2. 4 and 10 are even; 3 and 7 are odd.

questions.question: Which of these is a solid?
questions.explanation: A pencil has a fixed shape and volume, so it is a solid.

questions.question: Gases have a fixed volume.
questions.explanation: Gases have neither a fixed shape nor a fixed volume — they fill their container.
